left.heading: Ganymede
bullets: Icy moon with a subsurface saltwater ocean beneath its crust
Largest moon in the solar system, bigger than Mercury
Weak magnetic field induced by Jupiter's magnetosphere
Thin oxygen atmosphere detected by Galileo
Possible habitability in its subsurface ocean

right.heading: Titan
bullets: Saturn's largest moon, second largest in the solar system
Thick nitrogen atmosphere with surface pressure 1.5x Earth's
Methane lakes and seas near the poles
Huygens probe landed in 2005, first outer solar system landing
